title: Parchís Party
tagline: Roll, race and capture your way home.
description: The classic Parchís board game with a cast of characters instead of plain pieces. Pick a Knight, Wizard, Pirate, Robot, Ninja, Cat, Viking or Chef, roll the dice and hop your team around the board. Capture rivals, build blockades and race all four of your characters into the goal first.
features: Classic Parchís rules: captures, safe squares, blockades and bonus moves
8 characters, each with its own attack sound
2 to 4 players on one PC, or with friends over Parsec
Full controller support, or mouse and keyboard
